criteria_basis: Predeclared engineering limits for this controlled flat-ground simulation; not a stability proof.

conventions.phase_duration: Sample count × dt; row labels describe the preceding control interval.
conventions.clearance: Selected foot geometry-center height above recorded fixed pre-lift center; not absolute floor distance.
conventions.support_margin: Independently recomputed from physical CoM and the other three measured foot centers in world XY.
conventions.support_displacement: Foot geometry-center displacement from fixed per-cycle shift anchors includes rolling and contact compliance; it is not a measurement of pure tangential slip.
conventions.landing_debounce: Pre-reload sampled selected-foot contacts must remain active with normal force >= 2 N; one boundary sample is allowed for control-start versus observation-end alignment.
conventions.force_cap: Bounds the MPC desired vertical force at MPC updates, not the measured contact reaction.
conventions.force_ramp_duration: The 3 s minimum for unload/reload is a declared check of this milestone's fixed controller schedule, not a universal dynamics requirement.
conventions.landing_impact: Peak simulated normal contact reaction in first 100 ms after contact; not a hardware impact measurement.
conventions.nlp_status: Status 2 denotes the configured SQP iteration limit; underlying QP status must remain zero.

completed.requirement: Completed status and exactly 3 completed cycles

cycle_labels.requirement: Every requested cycle appears in chronological order

sample_clock.requirement: Continuous end-of-interval sampling with no reset or time gap

control_alignment.requirement: Control timestamp equals interval endpoint minus dt

qp_success.requirement: Every MPC update has QP status 0

nlp_status.requirement: Post-settling MPC NLP status is 0 or 2

selected_force_cap.requirement: Desired selected-foot vertical force <= configured cap + 1 N at MPC updates

body_tilt.requirement: Maximum absolute roll or pitch < 8 degrees

cycle_1_phase_order.requirement: All stages occur once in stand→shift→unload→lift→hold→lower→confirm→reload→recenter order

cycle_1_hold_duration.requirement: Continuous hold >= 6 s with at most one sample of boundary tolerance

cycle_1_hold_contact.requirement: Selected foot has neither contact nor planned support; other three have both for every hold sample

cycle_1_swing_schedule.requirement: Selected planned support remains off and the other three remain on throughout lift/hold/lower/confirm

cycle_1_support_contact_continuity.requirement: All three support feet retain measured contact throughout unload/lift/hold/lower/confirm/reload

cycle_1_hold_clearance.requirement: Selected foot remains >= 20 mm above its fixed pre-lift center height throughout hold

cycle_1_support_margin.requirement: Physical CoM projection has >= 10 mm margin inside measured three-foot support triangle during hold

cycle_1_fixed_lift_reference.requirement: Immutable lift anchor and constant hold target 0.03 m above it, with zero desired velocity/acceleration

cycle_1_foot_tracking.requirement: Selected-foot 3D error < 12 mm during lift, hold, lower and confirm

cycle_1_support_slip.requirement: All three support feet stay within 10 mm of their fixed positions at shift entry

cycle_1_lift_entry_guard.requirement: Last unload sample before lift: selected normal < 3 N, each support > 5 N, physical margin >= 20 mm, selected cap <= 0.1 N

cycle_1_force_cap_ramps.requirement: Unload and reload each last >= 3 s; held MPC force cap decreases monotonically on unload and increases on reload

cycle_1_reload_gate.requirement: Reload follows confirm and recorded dwell >= 0.1 s; preceding contacts independently active at >= 2 N for that debounce minus at most one boundary sample
